dialoguesToLoad.text: What is this place?
We are inside your mind.
Mir! What are you doing here?
My name is Therion Tou Telous.
What? Why do you look like him then?
It's a long story...
It's strange... Your name feels familiar... It's way too long, though. How about just Therion?
What? Don't you dare butcher my name.
I don't even remember the rest, anyway.
I knew it would turn out like this...
Anyway. What am I doing here? I don't have time for this. My friends are in danger.
And to help them, you need my strength.
Yeah, Raghnall is so strong... It felt like I was landing blows but it did nothing.
I can lend you my power, Zack.
Really? Let's go then!
There is a cost for it, though... You need-
Just do your thing. We have no time to waste.
Will you listen? This kid, I swear...
Sorry. But the others are fighting him!
Don't worry about that. In the world outside, Time if frozen.
Do you have something to do with my visions? Why did you wait so long to talk to me?
Your visions are caused by the crystal in your chest. I am in the crystal you found in Landfall Village. They are like two sides of a coin.
That's why it felt familiar.
This crystal contains tremendous power. If you combine the crystal with the one in your chest, you will gain incredible power.
Cool let's do it.
You have to be careful. This surge of strength will only be temporary.
As long as it's enough to beat his ass, I'm good.
